section: 第三章　电能的生产、输送和利用
title: 电能的产生

prose.text:
Electrical energy is convenient to transmit, distribute and convert.
Wires can carry it to distant places, where it can be distributed to different users.
Suitable devices can convert electrical energy into mechanical energy, internal energy, light and other forms.
prose.source_text: 较之所有其它形式的能，电能具有无可争辩的优越性.它可以沿导线输送到很远的距离而损耗较小，在用户之间分配方便. 并且主要的是，用极其简单的设备就可以很容易地把电能转化为任何其它形式的能：机械能，内(热)能，光能等等.

prose.text:
A transformer can change the voltage and current of alternating electricity over a wide range.
An ideal transformer does not lose energy, but a real transformer does.
Changing voltage and current is important in many electrical and radio devices, as well as in long-distance power transmission.
prose.source_text: 交流电较之直流电具有的优越性是电压和电流强度可以在很大范围内升降变化而几乎没有能量损失. 这样的变化在很多电的和无线电技术设备中都是必需的. 然而，在远距离传送电能时变压和变流的必要性就更大.

prose.text:
Devices that supply electrical energy convert other forms of energy into electrical energy.
Examples include batteries, electrostatic generators, thermopiles① and the solar cells used on spacecraft.
A fuel cell can convert the chemical energy released by a reaction between hydrogen and oxygen into electrical energy.
A magnetohydrodynamic generator uses hot ionized gas, or plasma, flowing through a magnetic field to convert energy of the gas into electrical energy.
prose.source_text: 电流是在发电设备中产生的. 这些发电设备能把各种形式的能转化为电能. 伽伐尼电池，静电起电机，温差电堆①，宇宙飞船上用的太阳能电池等都属于发电设备. 正在研究制造新型的发电机的可能性. 例如，制造一种所谓燃料电池.在这种电池中由于氢和氧反应所放出的能量直接转化为电能. 在建造磁流体发电机方面也进行了有成效的工作；在这种发电机中，在磁场中运动的炽热的离态气体流(等离子体)的机械能直接转化为电能.

prose.text: ① A thermopile uses the electromotive force produced when junctions made from different materials are at different temperatures.
prose.label: footnote
prose.source_text: ① 在温差电堆里，利用的是不同材料的两个接点由于两端的温度差而产生电动势的性质.

prose.text:
The characteristics of each device determine where it is useful.
An electrostatic generator can produce a large potential difference, but it supplies only a small current.
A battery bank can supply a larger current, but its operating time is limited by conditions such as the energy stored in it.
prose.source_text: 上述各种发电设备中，每一种的应用范围由它们的特性决定. 如象静电起电机能产生很高的电势差，但不能在电路里产生稍为大点的电流强度. 伽伐尼电池组可以供给大的电流，但它作用的持续时间不长.

prose.text:
An **electromechanical induction AC generator** converts mechanical energy into electrical energy by electromagnetic induction.
Its basic principle and structure are relatively simple, and a suitable design can produce the required voltage and supply a large current to a load.
prose.source_text: 在现代，**机电感应式交流发电机**起着占优势的作用. 在这些发电机里，机械能转化为电能. 它们的作用是以电磁感应现象为基础的. 这样的发电机有比较简单的结构，并且在足够高的电压下能够获得强大的电流.

prose.text: In the rest of this chapter, the term “generator” refers to an electromechanical induction AC generator.
prose.source_text: 往后，我们说到发电机时，指的就是机电感应式交流发电机.
